diffuseAlbedo.note: Reddish-brown heartwood darkened with age; no measured colour was read: a first value read from museum photographs of panel backs.

refractiveIndex.source: Marschner, S.R., Westin, S.H., Arbree, A. & Moon, J.T. (2005) Measuring and modeling the appearance of finished wood, ACM Transactions on Graphics 24(3) (as cited in the timber records)

porosity.source: Meier, E. The Wood Database: Honduran Mahogany (Swietenia macrophylla), https://www.wood-database.com/honduran-mahogany/ (average dried weight 590 kg/m3; SG 0.52 basic, 0.59 at 12 % MC); cell-wall density 1500 kg/m3 (Siau 1995), as in the oak record
porosity.note: Checked against both sources. The value is unchanged and now has a source. Richter & Dallwitz (https://www.delta-intkey.com/wood/en/www/melswmac.htm, opened) give a basic specific gravity of 0.4-0.5-0.65 g/cm3. Because that figure is basic rather than air-dry, the porosity range it implies (0.57-0.73) is only approximate. This assumes S. macrophylla. Denser Cuban S. mahagoni would give a lower porosity.

wettingDepth.note: As the oak: the depth a finish soaks into.

grain.source: Richter, H.G. & Dallwitz, M.J. Commercial timbers: Swietenia macrophylla King, https://www.delta-intkey.com/wood/en/www/melswmac.htm
grain.note: Vessel tangential diameter is 90-160-255 um (mean 160 um), with 2-18 vessels per mm2. Corrected from the proposal: rays are '1-2-4(-5) cells wide' and '5-10 per tangential mm', and the storied structure is 'present or absent'.

bed.note: A growth ring's width; mahogany's rings are faint.

bedAspect.note: How much coarser the figure is along the grain than across it: a straight-grained board.

hurst.source: Candela et al. 2012, Journal of Geophysical Research 117, B08409 (fault surfaces, 0.6 to 0.8; cited in Stone.ush)
hurst.note: The middle of the range measured on rock surfaces, as the travertine's.

toneSpread.note: A first half-range of ln(albedo) across one face.

roughnessSpread.note: A first half-range of ln(roughness), as the oak's.

rayFleck.note: How much of a quarter-sawn face the rays show.
